decisions.reason: Changing the editable-field mechanism does not remove or alter the independent requirement that interactive fields have labels.
A more robust field mechanism does not change the required behavior that placeholder text clears when the field is activated.
Template theme colors are independent of the mechanism used for editable text fields.
The source decision concerns editable form controls and does not alter Tab-based list hierarchy behavior.
Bullet appearance requirements remain valid unchanged and are unrelated to the editable-field mechanism.
The request for a more robust editable-field approach does not necessarily change the separate legacy copy-paste workflow requirement.
Manual line-break behavior after pasted content is independent of the selected editable-field control mechanism.
The required style-set coverage is not changed by selecting a more robust approach for editable fields.
Table and column stability during paste is independent of editable text-field controls.
The task-local assessment deliverables are not changed by the product decision to use a more robust editable-field approach.
